name: encode_batch_archive

test_list.description: The deterministic tar contains the typed manifest first and preserves exact file bytes including CRLF and NUL.
Payload digests, protected paths and mutation limits fail closed before transfer.

inputs.name: batch
inputs.description: Root-bound path mutations, expected states and synthetic payload references.

inputs.name: payloads
inputs.description: Exact bytes for each referenced synthetic payload member.

output_description: A deterministic uncompressed tar bounded to 32 MiB with no workspace paths as archive members.
